title: Implement user and system context injection
objective: Move date, CLAUDE.md, and Git status into original-equivalent context layers instead of embedding all dynamic content inside the base system prompt.
context: The original prepends user context as a meta user message wrapped in <system-reminder>.
The original appends system context such as gitStatus to the system prompt before API submission.
Go currently inserts date, cwd, git, and instruction files directly into the system string.
deliverables: Add UserContext and SystemContext builder types.
Inject user context as a leading meta/system-reminder user message before model calls.
Append system context as a trailing system prompt block before provider submission.
Prepare claudeMd and gitStatus fields even if full discovery remains implemented by later tasks.
acceptance: Date no longer appears in the static base system prompt.
CLAUDE-style instructions can be injected through a system-reminder user message.
Git status can be appended as system context rather than included in base prompt text.
Tests prove message ordering and block ordering.
non_goals: Do not implement full CLAUDE.md discovery in this task.
Do not implement prompt cache scope decisions.
Do not change provider-specific serialization beyond accepting the new system block sequence.
handoff_notes: Coordinate with task_04 and task_07 so their builders plug into this context layer rather than rebuilding request plumbing.
